- Must-have: SAML SSO + SSO provisioning; SOC2 evidence for security review
- Success metric for pilot: throughput at target latency and integration of SSO + artifacts ingestion

Proposed next meeting slots (all ET):
1) Wed, Sep 20 — 10:00–10:45 AM ET
2) Thu, Sep 21 — 9:00–9:45 AM ET
3) Tue, Sep 26 — 11:00–11:45 AM ET

Please confirm which slot works best and who'll join from your side (specially security/procurement). I’ve cc’d Karthik (platform/SSO), Marissa (customer success/pilot ops) and Mina (security/compliance) so we can align internal owners.

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.
